Summary: I compared four password managers for the family plan (1Password, Bitwarden, Proton Pass, Dashlane).

- Bitwarden is the cheapest at $40/year for 6 users and is open source.
- 1Password has the best UX and travel mode, $60/year.
- Proton Pass is bundled if Tony upgrades Proton Mail.
- Dashlane dropped its free tier and is the most expensive.

Recommendation: Bitwarden for cost, 1Password if the family values ease of use. Tony should decide whether shared vaults per kid matter — that would favour 1Password.

Sources: vendor pricing pages fetched today; two independent reviews.
